description: Read a masked OpenTrain freelancer profile by user id or public profile slug for candidate evaluation: title, bio, skills, stats (earned, billed hours, job success), work/label experience, education, reviews, and languages. Requires proposals:read scope. Names are masked to first name + last initial and personal contact details (including personal email) are never returned; contact strings embedded in candidate-authored free text are replaced server-side with explicit [REDACTED_*] placeholders, with field-level provenance in the response redactions array (never the removed value). Employer-authored review comments go through the same pass and also lose links ([REDACTED_LINK]: URLs, www addresses, hosts with a path, and domain names under country-code or common top-level domains), recorded with source EMPLOYER_REVIEW and field reviews[<index>].comment; a clean comment gets no entry. The stored review is unchanged, and agency.website stays as a public business field.

idOrSlug.description: OpenTrain freelancer user id or public profile slug to read.

name: opentrain_get_freelancer_profile
